title: Model Gateway Service wire contract
description: Versioned language-neutral HTTP and JSON contract for the standalone Model Gateway Service.

nativeCompatibility.description: Endpoint-path compatibility only for the priced text and client-executed-tool subset; the service rejects multimodal content, provider-managed tools, unpriced selectors, and unknown fields.

fixedPointScale.description: Settled ledger charges and cost reservations use microcurrency units; aggregate token costs are rounded up once.

tokenRateScale.description: Token rates preserve exact currency nanounits. Operator-supplied input/output rates are ceilings for local quota and ledger estimates, not verified provider prices or a guarantee of invoice totals. Review all applicable model/account/endpoint price categories before traffic and bind a new immutable revision if a stored ceiling is insufficient; stored rates are not rewritten automatically.

inputTokenEstimate.description: Preflight input usage counts the complete UTF-8 JSON request byte length; Anthropic requests with client tools add 804 tokens, the highest model/choice overhead in Anthropic's published tool-use table as of 2026-10-08. Operators must review other configured aliases against that table because no per-model adjustment is available. Provider-reported usage is used for settlement.
